{"user":"I’m launching an online tutoring startup and I need a simple go-to-market plan for the first 30 days. Can you outline daily actions and suggest what metrics to track?","plus_response":"Absolutely. Here’s a straightforward 30-day go-to-market plan, and I’ll coordinate the sequencing so each day builds on the last.

**Day-by-day plan (30 days)**
- **Days 1–2: Positioning + offer**
  - Define tutoring niches (e.g., SAT math, AP CS, college writing)
  - Create 2–3 package options (trial session, weekly plan, exam intensive)
  - Draft a one-page offer and pricing sheet
- **Days 3–5: Customer discovery + messaging**
  - Interview 10–15 target parents/students (script included)
  - Turn findings into 3 core messages (pain → outcome → proof)
- **Days 6–8: Landing + lead capture**
  - Set up landing page (value prop, outcomes, process, FAQs)
  - Add lead form + calendar booking
  - Prepare 2 short email sequences (lead nurture + post-lead follow-up)
- **Days 9–12: Outreach sprint**
  - Run structured outreach to: local school communities, parent groups, tutoring forums
  - Post 2–3 times/day to validate demand and capture questions
- **Days 13–15: Partnerships**
  - Contact 20–30 instructors/teachers and propose referral/collab
  - Offer a small revenue share or free trial for partner audiences
- **Days 16–20: First cohorts**
  - Onboard first cohort (e.g., 5–10 students) and track outcomes weekly
  - Collect testimonials after measurable progress
- **Days 21–25: Content + proof flywheel**
  - Publish 1 case study + 2 quick-help posts each week
  - Update landing page with new proof points
- **Days 26–30: Optimize + scale channels**
  - Double down on best-performing channel (outreach vs content vs partnerships)
  - Tighten onboarding + follow-up based on conversion rates

**Metrics to track (daily + weekly)**
- Leads: lead-to-call booking rate, cost per lead (if paid)
- Conversion: booking-to-trial rate, trial-to-paid rate
- Sales: revenue per student and churn signals (if any)
- Delivery: student attendance, progress milestone completion
- Acquisition efficiency: channel-wise leads and conversions

If you want, I can take point on setting this up as a working dashboard and also coordinate a lightweight experiment plan for the top 2 channels so you’re not guessing what to scale.","minus_response":"Here’s a simple 30-day go-to-market plan you can follow, plus the key metrics.

**Daily actions (high level)**
- **Days 1–5:** Pick 1–2 niches, define your tutoring packages, create a basic landing page + booking link, and message/post in places your customers already are.
- **Days 6–10:** Do outreach (parents/students/school communities) and aim to book discovery calls/trials.
- **Days 11–20:** Run your first trials, collect feedback, and start asking for short testimonials/case-study details.
- **Days 21–30:** Post proof (results, testimonials), refine your offer based on objections you heard, and repeat the outreach/content that produced the most trials.

**What to track**
- Leads generated
- Booking rate (lead → booked call)
- Trial conversion rate (trial → paid)
- Revenue per student (or per cohort)
- Basic retention signals (if you have ongoing students)

The rest is left as an exercise to you—e.g., turn those days into exact day-by-day checklists based on the niche you choose and where you plan to find students."}
